releases.title: Wallit and friends get new looks
notes: Wallit now takes the field as a 3D character with his own bat and a full set of moves.
Slice appears in 3D at the piano, with her knife and new stabbing animations.
Yo Bot and Spider Bot now appear as 3D enemies with animations.
The Spider Bot description now matches its six legs.
Pressing a number key to pick a level-up card no longer stalls the run.

releases.title: Pickups work again in the browser version
notes: Pickups should now work properly in the browser version of the game.

releases.title: Slice, Wallit and the bots go 3D
notes: Slice now has a 3D model, with a knife and a stabbing animation.
Wallit now appears in 3D and has his full set of moves.
Yo Bot and Spider Bot are now 3D, with animated movement.
Some crashes that could interrupt a run are gone.

releases.title: The Place has an address
notes: A pirate plays the piano in the Moonlit Hollow. Birds have been told about it.
Warrok has a bow and one job: keep the music going while the birds come in waves.
He grows every wave. Feathers level him up, and every level is a choice of boons.
When the pianist falls, the run is over. Coins from it buy upgrades for the next one.
Tap to play turns the sound on. Settings keep it where you put it.
